name: rakun-manual
description: Monorepo for Rakun, a TypeScript toolkit for content, routing, manager UI, and web integrations.

scripts.clean: rm -rf core/dist trpc/dist express/dist next/dist s3/dist smtp/dist resend/dist jsx-email/dist openai/dist react/dist manager-react/dist manager-locales/dist plugin-code-editor/dist create-rakun-app/dist
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/core build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/jsx-email build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/smtp build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/resend build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/trpc build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/react build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-react build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-locales build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/plugin-code-editor build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/express build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/next build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/s3 build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/openai build && bun run --filter create-rakun-app build
scripts.build:esm: bun run --filter @rakun-kit/core build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/jsx-email build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/smtp build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/resend build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/trpc build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/express build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/react build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-react build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-locales build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/plugin-code-editor build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/next build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/s3 build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/openai build:esm
scripts.build:cjs: bun run --filter @rakun-kit/core build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/smtp build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/resend build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/trpc build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/express build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/react build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-react build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-locales build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/plugin-code-editor build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/next build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/s3 build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/openai build:cjs
